name: GitLab API
tagline: REST and GraphQL API for GitLab projects, issues, CI/CD, and repositories.
description: GitLab provides a comprehensive REST API (v4) and GraphQL API for managing projects, repositories, issues, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines, users, and more. Available on GitLab.com (SaaS) and self-managed instances. Supports personal access tokens, OAuth 2.0, and project/group access tokens for authentication.

auth.details: Personal/project/group access token via PRIVATE-TOKEN header or Authorization: Bearer. OAuth 2.0 also supported. Self-serve signup on GitLab.com.

pricing.free_tier_limits: GitLab.com Free plan includes API access; rate limits apply (see rate_limits). Paid tiers (Premium, Ultimate) add features, not separate API pricing.
pricing.paid_plans: Free, Premium, Ultimate (per-user/seat pricing for Premium/Ultimate); self-managed has separate licensing.

rate_limits: GitLab.com enforces rate limits; exact numbers vary by endpoint and plan — check docs for current unauthenticated/authenticated limits.
use_cases: list projects the authenticated user belongs to
create or update issues on a GitLab project
read merge request status and comments
clone or inspect repository file contents via API
manage project members and access tokens
